## SpatialCopyInference-paper

<hr style="border: none; height: 2px; background-color: #2C7FB8;">

This website accompanies the **SpatialCopyInference** preprint and provides supplementary analyses.

**Inferring somatic copy number aberrations from spatial transcriptomics data to study early cancer development**

F Honig, C Brochen, M Basha, R Arora, M Jimenez-Linan, AC Antoniou, OM Rueda, F Correia Martins

bioRxiv 2026.10.23.761433 

[Read the preprint](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.10.23.761433v1.article-info)

<br>

## Available analyses:

<hr class="section-divider">

##### [Cell annotation refinement](Cell_annotation_refinement.html)

- Refinement of cell type annotations, including re-evaluation of ciliated epithelial cells and identification of secretory epithelial cells as a distinct epithelial population.

##### [Cell type means](Cell_type_means.html)

- Comparison of chromosome arm-level mean expression profiles across annotated cell populations.

##### [Clustering parameter optimisation](Clustering_parameter_optimisation.html)

- Evaluation of BANKSY clustering parameters for spatial clustering.

##### [Normal region analyses](Normal_region_analyses.html)

- Analyses of cells belonging to the intermediate population located within the histologically normal fallopian tube.

##### [Normal region only clustering](Normal_region_only_clustering.html)

- Spatial clustering analysis using only cells from the normal fallopian tube epithelium.

##### [TCGA](TCGA.html)

- Reproduction of genome-wide somatic copy number alteration frequencies in the TCGA high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort.
